stories.title: Oregon State standout WR Legree re-signs with Beavers for '27
stories.summary: Oregon State freshman receiver Jesse Legree, one of the country's breakout stars in 2026, tells ESPN that he has re-signed with the Beavers for next season.

stories.title: Lamar 'heading in the right direction' with high ankle sprain
stories.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson said he's dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unsure if he'll play this week against the Bengals, but is "heading in the right direction" after missing the past two games.

stories.title: Bears TE Kmet to be 'sorely missed' after season-ending knee injury
stories.summary: Bears tight end Cole Kmet will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after he suffered a serious right knee injury during Chicago's 30-24 win over New England.
